basis: ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: SHED 2022 median outstanding education debt was $20,000-$24,999; midpoint $22,500. SHED 2019 typical required monthly payment was $200-$299. Recorded college attendance and household resources identify financing needs; balances vary with age and recorded pay. This is a financing estimate, not a random assignment of borrowers. A 120-month installment proxy at 4.53% (2019-20 undergraduate cohort) produces about $234 a month on $22,500. The 2022 proposed $10,000/$125,000 policy calibrates proposals, not starting law. Debt discharge mechanically eliminates the discharged loan's past-due balance; the effect on other debt must be measured through actual payments, not imposed from a rate.
